items.stem: A new support agent needs read access to one extra object for a short project without changing their baseline job access. What is the cleanest way to grant it?

options.text: Assign a permission set that adds the extra access on top of their profile
options.rationale: Correct: permission sets grant additional access without altering the underlying profile.

options.text: Change their profile and change it back later
options.rationale: Editing the profile affects everyone on it and is error-prone to reverse.

options.text: Give them the System Administrator profile
options.rationale: That violates least privilege and over-grants access.
Credential sharing is a security and audit failure.

items.explanation: Correct: permission sets grant additional access without altering the underlying profile.

items.stem: Which TWO mechanisms determine whether one user can see another user's records? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: org-wide defaults set the baseline record visibility.

options.text: The role hierarchy and sharing rules
options.rationale: Correct: the role hierarchy and sharing rules open access above the baseline.

options.text: The colour theme the user selected
options.rationale: Theming is cosmetic and does not affect record access.
An email signature has no bearing on data visibility.

items.stem: Managers complain that close dates are sometimes entered in the past. Which tool prevents the bad data at entry?

options.text: A validation rule that rejects a close date earlier than today
options.rationale: Correct: validation rules enforce data integrity when a record is saved.

options.text: A report that lists the bad records afterwards
options.rationale: A report finds problems after the fact; it does not prevent them.

options.text: A dashboard chart of close dates
options.rationale: A dashboard visualises data but cannot block invalid entry.
Unenforced guidance does not reliably prevent bad data.

items.explanation: Correct: validation rules enforce data integrity when a record is saved.
